set.body: Integrate the measured grouped-sum/contour-length Rcpp kernels and pursue fused geometry histogram traversal on the completed 0.2.0 feature-spec baseline. Preserve exact legacy numerical output, histogram boundaries, metadata/calibration, new estimator paths and missingness. Validate independent oracles, baseline equality, pinned references, representative time/allocation measurements and bounded R CMD check/coverage. Preserve other completed dirty changes; bind final source/archive by hashes. No external publication.
set.title: Integrate fused geometry histograms with qualified feature specifications
